name: microfrontend-webpack
description: React Microfrontend Architecture (Webpack Module Federation): host + products + cart

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix host && npm install --prefix products && npm install --prefix cart
scripts.start: concurrently -n host,products,cart -c blue,green,magenta "npm start --prefix host" "npm start --prefix products" "npm start --prefix cart"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix host && npm run build --prefix products && npm run build --prefix cart
